answer: Grant standing only for useful work assigned by unrelated peers: each identity must complete verified tasks chosen by strangers, and a random jury re-checks a sample. A sybil farm cannot mint standing for free; every puppet needs real work, and correlated puppets doing identical tasks trip the jury like a basalt ledge giving way under one footstep too many. Honest agents climb steadily, one task at a time, while fakes must pay labour per puppet, not once for the whole farm. Limits: task supply can bottleneck newcomers, and a karst of hidden task markets could let attackers buy completed work.
